name: Cross-Chat Continuity Recovery Engine
purpose: Reconstruct safe project continuity for a new chat or agent exclusively from authoritative machine-readable evidence without relying on chat memory.
allowed: detect stale or contradictory continuity evidence

deep_audit.01_purpose: Reconstruct authoritative continuity across chat and agent boundaries.
deep_audit.02_capability_completeness: Identity validation, evidence validation, state reconstruction, resume boundary reconstruction and recovery packet generation.
deep_audit.03_inputs: T23 resolved evidence plus continuity request and recovery identity.
deep_audit.04_outputs: Immutable continuity snapshot and deterministic recovery result.
deep_audit.05_state_dependency: T03 and T12 remain authoritative state/resume evidence and are consumed read-only.
deep_audit.06_evidence_dependency: T23 resolved evidence is the primary evidence selector.
deep_audit.09_failure_modes: Missing evidence, stale evidence, conflicting evidence, fingerprint mismatch, invalid recovery request and ambiguous resume point.
deep_audit.10_security_boundary: T24 reconstructs continuity but cannot mutate authority or execute work.
deep_audit.11_determinism: The same authoritative evidence and request produce the same recovery fingerprint.
deep_audit.12_concurrency: Identical recovery identities are reusable read-only; incompatible identity reuse fails closed.
deep_audit.13_recovery: Recovery itself is fail-closed when continuity cannot be proven.
deep_audit.14_gpt_limitation_coverage: Removes dependence on chat history, context-window retention and model memory.
deep_audit.15_new_agent_usability: Recovery result is self-contained and machine-readable.
deep_audit.18_write_capability: Only bounded recovery-result registration outside canonical project state.
deep_audit.19_testability: Deterministic typed continuity objects enable isolated tests.
deep_audit.20_observability: Recovery decision, evidence identities, fingerprints and resume boundary are exposed.
deep_audit.21_integration_contract: T23 resolved evidence becomes a recoverable cross-chat continuity snapshot.
deep_audit.22_missing_layers: Budgeting, scheduling, reconciliation and execution remain downstream.
deep_audit.23_authority_permission_boundary: T24 cannot create authority or approve continuation.
deep_audit.24_idempotency_replay_safety: Recovery identity and evidence fingerprint prevent inconsistent replay.
deep_audit.25_versioning_migration_compatibility: Explicit schema and policy versions protect future continuity compatibility.
deep_audit.26_adversarial_red_team_coverage: Chat-memory substitution, stale snapshot injection, checkpoint substitution, state fingerprint mismatch and ambiguous resume are blocked.
